**The paper does not report an AlpacaEval 2 win rate.** AlpacaEval is not mentioned anywhere in the document.

The paper reports these win rates instead, all judged by GPT-4 except where noted:

- **TL;DR summarization (vs. reference summaries):** DPO reaches about 61% at temperature 0.0. PPO's best is 57%, also at temperature 0.0 (p. 9; Figure 2 right, p. 7).
- **Human evaluation, DPO vs. PPO:** DPO samples at temperature 0.25 were preferred over PPO samples at temperature 0 58% of the time (p. 9). Table 2 gives the full figures for DPO vs. PPO-0: GPT-4 (S) 47%, GPT-4 (C) 54%, human 58% (p. 10).
- **Anthropic-HH single-turn dialogue (vs. preferred responses):** DPO is described as the only computationally efficient method that improves over the preferred completions. It performs similarly to or better than Best of 128 (pp. 8–9; Figure 3). The text gives no single exact number. From the Figure 3 plot, DPO appears to be around 0.6 at higher temperatures, but that is my reading of the chart.
- **Out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail (vs. ground-truth summaries):** DPO scores 0.36 at temperature 0 and 0.31 at temperature 0.25. PPO scores 0.26 and 0.23 (Table 1, p. 9).

AlpacaEval 2 results for DPO may come from later papers that use DPO as a baseline, but they are not in this document.
